title: The Dimension of Nothingness
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 28.7 Linked Discourses 28.7
  • 1. Sāriputtavagga 1. With Sāriputta

Ākiñcaññāyatanasutta The Dimension of Nothingness

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto …pe… Venerable Ānanda saw Venerable Sāriputta …

“idhāhaṁ, āvuso, sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṁ samatikkamma, natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṁ upasampajja viharāmi …pe… “Reverend, going totally beyond the dimension of infinite consciousness, aware that ‘there is nothing at all’, I entered and remained in the dimension of nothingness. …” … vuṭṭhitoti vā”ti.

Sattamaṁ.
